EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for contacting ASU College of Nursing and Health Innovation
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
{!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for your inquiry regarding our BS Health Care Innovation program.
As the face of healthcare continues to change across a national and global scale, it is important for educational institutions to prepare students for the future of health. The College of Nursing and Health Innovation aims to prepare lifelong, dynamic learners who are able to adapt and overcome complex challenges involved with health.
The BS in Health Care Innovation is the first of its kind in the country, intended for students who want to lead transformative change in health through the creation of new products, processes and systems. The BS in Health Care Innovation is an interdisciplinary degree designed to prepare graduates to manage the implementation of health care innovation. This degree will provide students with a broad background in principles of innovation, leadership, complexity science, change theory, collaboration, and evidence-based decision making to prepare graduates to manage implementation of innovation in the health care arena.
This is a unique degree that situates students at the intersection of innovation and entrepreneurship in health and healing. Graduates may be employed as entrepreneurs, intrapreneurs, practitioners, health system designers, health architects, health product or service managers, public relations experts in health, health care strategists, advisors, project managers, and/or administrators.
Program Requirements
To view the BS Health Care Innovation degree requirements and submit an application click this link https://webapp4.asu.edu/programs/t5/majorinfo/ASU00/NUHCIBS/undergrad/false.
Our BS Health Care Innovation program is available on the Downtown Phoenix campus and the West campus. To view the plan of study, please click this link https://webapp4.asu.edu/programs/t5/roadmaps/ASU00/NUHCIBS/null/ALL/2015. The course descriptions are hyperlinked within the major maps.
Benefits of pursuing a degree with ASU
Growing your career and leading others Gaining broader perspectives on integrative health approaches and practices Surrounding yourself with expert faculty and quality mentors Preparing to positively impact health outcomes Applying theory and research to practice
